message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-03 05:10 IST. High-confidence new relevant findings were found for Ubiquiti/UniFi and WinRAR. No confirmed new vulnerabilities were found for the other monitored products in this window.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Ubiquiti/UniFi, including UniFi Connect, UniFi OS, UniFi Protect, and UniFi Access components
- Issue: Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 066, including CVE-2026-50746, CVE-2026-54402, CVE-2026-55115, CVE-2026-55116, CVE-2026-50748, and related UniFi CVEs
- Severity: Critical for several entries, including CVSS 10.0 for CVE-2026-50746, CVSS 9.9 for CVE-2026-54402 / CVE-2026-55115 / CVE-2026-50748, and CVSS 9.0 for CVE-2026-55116.
- Why it matters: Ubiquiti/UniFi is listed in Products.txt. The newly published advisory covers command injection, improper access control, path traversal/authentication bypass, and SSRF-style privilege-escalation issues across UniFi device and application components. Several issues are network-reachable and could affect management-plane security if vulnerable UniFi components are deployed.
- Source: Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 066 (https://community.ui.com/releases/Security-Advisory-Bulletin-066-066/984eceb3-49c8-4227-942d-671c289b3afc), GitHub Advisory for CVE-2026-54402 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-ghgx-h467-6r25), GitHub Advisory for CVE-2026-55115 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9prq-fx52-ppcv), GitHub Advisory for CVE-2026-55116 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hh99-693c-cjm3), and CVE Record for CVE-2026-50746 (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-50746).

**Finding 2**

- Product: WinRAR / UnRAR
- Issue: CVE-2026-14191
- Severity: Not clearly stated in the primary source reviewed.
- Why it matters: WinRAR is listed in Products.txt. Malwarebytes reported on July 2, 2026 that RARLAB released WinRAR 7.23 to fix a RAR5 recovery-volume handling vulnerability that can corrupt memory and may be abused for remote code execution when a user opens crafted recovery-volume files.
- Source: Malwarebytes report (https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/07/winrar-flaw-could-allow-attackers-to-take-control-of-your-computer) and CVE Record for CVE-2026-14191 (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-14191).

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

- Product family: WordPress
- Issue: Several WordPress plugin CVEs were published or indexed on July 2, 2026 for plugins such as WPIDE, ProfileGrid, Kit for WooCommerce, Booked, and POS Entegrator.
- Severity: Mixed; examples in public feeds ranged from Medium to High.
- Why it needs review: WordPress is listed in Products.txt, but the product list only names WordPress itself plus Yoast SEO and Advanced Custom Fields. I did not find a fresh July 2 advisory for WordPress core, Yoast SEO, or Advanced Custom Fields, and I could not verify that the newly reported third-party plugins are in scope for the monitored environment.
- Source: CIRCL Vulnerability-Lookup recent feed (https://vulnerability.circl.lu/recent), Wordfence Yoast SEO vulnerability record (https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/wordpress-seo), and Wordfence Advanced Custom Fields record (https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/advanced-custom-fields).

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for any deployed UniFi components because multiple Critical issues were published in the current window. WinRAR should also be reviewed where installed, especially because the product does not automatically update and exploitation depends on users opening crafted archive recovery files.
